definitions: The act of removing the top layer of dead skin cells from the surface of the skin, typically using a scrub or chemical peel, to improve its appearance and texture.
The process by which a material, such as rock or a mineral, sheds or peels off in layers or scales.
examples: She enjoys exfoliating her skin weekly.
The rock was exfoliating due to weathering.
Exfoliating regularly can lead to smoother skin.
